Frequently asked questions
Where is Pets Bay Clinic located?
Pets Bay Clinic is at الحجاز, street، حي العجوزة، محافظة الجيزة 3752520, Agouza, Giza. Use the “Open in Maps” button on this page for directions. You can take the Cairo Metro if a station is close, a taxi or a ride-hailing app such as Uber, Careem or inDrive, or drive, allowing for traffic and scarce parking in busy districts.
What kind of business is Pets Bay Clinic?
Pets Bay Clinic is listed as a veterinary clinic.
What are the opening hours of Pets Bay Clinic?
Published hours (Cairo time) are Monday: open 24 hours; Tuesday: open 24 hours; Wednesday: open 24 hours; Thursday: open 24 hours; Friday: open 24 hours; Saturday: open 24 hours; Sunday: open 24 hours. Hours often change during Ramadan, Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha and other public holidays such as Sham El-Nessim, so call before a special trip.
Is Pets Bay Clinic open on Friday?
Yes, on Friday it is open open 24 hours. It may close briefly for Friday prayers (around 12:00–13:30); Friday is the weekly day off in Egypt, and government offices and banks also close on Saturday.
What is the phone number of Pets Bay Clinic?
You can call Pets Bay Clinic on 010 9919 9184.
How is Pets Bay Clinic rated?
Pets Bay Clinic has a general rating of 4.7 out of 5 from 260 reviews.
Are there other veterinary clinics near Pets Bay Clinic?
Yes. Agouza also has Agouza Vet Clinic, Vet Help Clinic عيادة بيطرية among others; see the full list of veterinary clinics in Agouza at the bottom of this page.
